candidate.display_name: GHOST Energy x A&W Root Beer
candidate.exact_object_rule: Retain an original post only when GHOST is tied to A&W, AW or Root Beer by an adjacent product phrase, or a known GHOST Energy/Lifestyle identity is paired with A&W, AW or Root Beer. Reject distant namesake collisions such as ghost hunting plus an unrelated A&W mention. X search results that are replies remain child context rather than original posts. Comments and replies inherit only from a retained exact original post.

retention_rules.original_post_only: A returned search item is eligible as an original post only when source lineage does not identify it as a reply. An exact X reply remains disclosed child context and is not counted as an original post.
retention_rules.provider_record_audit: Persist every normalized provider result with its native ID, URL, text, author, exact-object decision, original-post decision and rejection reasons so semantic no-match rows remain independently re-verifiable.
retention_rules.deduplication: Deduplicate original posts and child records by platform plus native ID. Preserve every matched query and attempt reference.

status_rules.complete_relevant: The authenticated query completed and returned at least one exact original product post.
status_rules.complete_no_match: The authenticated query returned posts, but all failed the exact product or original-post rule.
status_rules.empty: The authenticated source exposed an explicit no-results state with zero parsed posts.
status_rules.failed: Authentication, network, parser, timeout, budget or ambiguous-zero result; never convert this to zero conversation.
status_rules.bounded_partial: A thread read returned records without a connector error but the source reported more records or the cap was reached.

old_method_defect: The prior GHOST monitor delegated to the generic candidate collector. For this canonical query that produced only one X phrase, one TikTok phrase, and a small Instagram fallback basket.
The prior widened run used collect-only mode with comment hydration disabled, so it read zero comments or replies even when a retained post could have had a thread.

The first correction still omitted the common AW spelling alias on X and did not preserve provider text for semantically rejected rows, so it missed a verified exact post and made exclusions impossible to re-audit from that artifact alone.
A search result can itself be a reply. Counting it as an original post inflates breadth; source lineage must decide root versus child before retention.
Ranked bounded search and one phrase cannot establish platform-wide absence. The corrected result reports only what the frozen authenticated queries observed within their caps.
recovery_procedure: Preserve and hash every source artifact; never edit collection history in place.
Freeze the unresolved platform-query and original-post-thread keys before spending on retries.
Rerun only the unresolved platform after its same-shape known-positive search and depth canary passes.
Run every frozen source-native product query even after one query finds a post, then preserve provider rows and deduplicate accepted original posts by platform and native post ID.
Apply the exact product rule and source-native original-post lineage rule before reading threads.
Read comments and replies for every retained exact original post within the frozen cap and depth, recording returned count, source-reported total, truncation, route and error.
Merge prior successful attempts and retries by platform and native ID, reject conflicting root or ancestry metadata, recompute counts offline, and retain every attempt in audit history.
Classify every retained original post's commercial origin. Only possible_organic may count as independently qualifying behavior; all exact posts still count toward total observed buzz.
A new wider query basket starts a new baseline and must not be described as momentum versus the old smaller basket.
